neighbours.label: character stats and +/- bonus or penalty modifiers in tabletop game rules
fire: Your fighter has a Strength of 16, which gives a +3 bonus to melee attack rolls.
Halflings gain +2 Dexterity but suffer a -1 penalty to Strength.
While blinded, the creature takes a -4 penalty on all attack rolls.
Add your Wisdom modifier (+2) to the Perception check.
The cursed ring imposes a -2 penalty to Armor Class until removed.
Elves receive a +1 racial bonus to Intelligence at character creation.
Flanking an enemy grants a +2 circumstance bonus to hit.
A Constitution score of 8 gives a -1 modifier to hit points per level.
quiet: Humans should make the best use of given information at any time.
The dungeon master describes a dark, damp corridor.
Your fighter swings his sword at the orc and the blade bites deep into its shield.
The halfling was quick on her feet but not very strong, and she knew it.
The blinded creature stumbled around the cave, groping at the walls.
She paused, listened carefully, and heard footsteps coming from the hall.
The cursed ring glowed faintly before the wizard dropped it into the river.
The elves lived in a hidden city among the ancient trees.
